gold_sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-71.846095 44.946032, -71.858095 44.875062, -71.857965 44.86803, -71.85317 44.865438, -71.834282 44.855222, -71.815353 44.875048, -71.81517 44.875258, -71.811133 44.879898, -71.777887 44.918093, -71.76652 44.931146, -71.754887 44.944628, -71.752211 44.947728, -71.785666 44.947196, -71.796196 44.947029, -71.846095 44.946032))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).max AS slope
FROM region_slope;
